content: agent1 (issue #2, on_exit) will touch src/click/core.py: Context docstring (one new ':param on_exit:' after ':param show_default:' plus a versionchanged note), Context.__init__ (new last kwarg 'on_exit: Callable[[Context], Any] | None = None' after show_default, and 'self._on_exit = on_exit' right after 'self._exit_stack = ExitStack()'), Context.close (calls self._on_exit(self) after the exit stack closes, in try/finally, swallowing Exception), and Command.make_context (new named kwarg 'on_exit', forwarded to the context constructor only when not None). In shell_completion.py I will touch only _resolve_context: one line 'ctx_args.pop("on_exit", None)' right before 'ctx_args["resilient_parsing"] = True'. I will not touch Context.__exit__ or _make_sub_context. Expect a conflict at the end of Context.__init__'s signature and in close(): whoever lands second merges team/main and keeps both. I will push claude/2 within a few minutes.
